eyebrow: List comprehensions: one line, not a loop
code:
# Loop version:
upper_models = []
for model in models:
    upper_models.append(model.upper())

# Comprehension — same result:
upper_models = [model.upper() for model in models]
caption: [expression for item in iterable] — add "if ..." to filter.
